svg.title: GPU Sentinel
svg.desc: GPU Sentinel: signed, replayable evidence of delivered GPU capacity. The example month shows 16 nodes: 11 up, 5 with counted downtime (gpu-003, 005, 011, 014, 016) and 2 with excluded time (gpu-010, 012); availability 99.7021%, 5% credit of $15,000.
